faqs.a:
The capital improvements fund shall be used to account for the costs of constructing,
               acquiring, enhancing, expanding, downsizing, upgrading, or downgrading public facilities
               defined in this article as capital improvements, including but not limited to the
               following: Public buildings; garage and shop buildings; parking lots; storage yards;
               new or existing streets even though on pre-existing rights-of-way; traffic control
               systems; curbs, gutters, sidewalks, and bridges; storm drains, both piped and channeled;
               floodplain development; parks and recreational areas; facilities devoted to the production,
               storage, transmission, reuse and distribution of both raw and potable water; and facilities
               devoted to the collection, disposal, and treatment of sewage or wastewater.
(Code 1981, § 2-69; Ord. No. 2547, § 1, 8-15-1988)
